name: @arena/capability-learning-service
description: Arena capability-learning reference compiler service (Work Order C022; issue #128). Candidate ingestion → program compilation → experiment orchestration → gated proposal dispatch as durable idempotent jobs on the A015 fabric: intervention-derived improvement candidates are ingested through the injected seam (C008 tool-gap/knowledge candidates, C009 escalation-validation evidence, C013 adversarial research candidates, C014 marketplace pretraining candidates — projected into @arena/capability-learning's typed candidate views by the host), compiled deterministically into typed ImprovementPrograms (one per LE1.0 intervention class; blocked outcomes are audited, never silently dropped), each compilable program assembles to an A020 ExperimentDescriptor and executes through the injected A020 experiment-engine port, the Q1.0 five-condition capability-lift gate decides adoption (typed verdicts, never a bare boolean), and ONLY adopted improvements are dispatched as gated proposals into the A021 Body Forge, A022 compatibility re-testing and A023 recertification surfaces through their public ports (adoption of an ungated improvement is structurally impossible). Every compile→gate→dispatch decision lands in the append-only, tamper-evident audit stream; the feedback ledger records which interventions produced which improvements with what measured lift and ranks future selection by expected information value. All failures are typed and fail-closed; time is injected; tenant isolation is enforced at every seam.
